keys.swarm.aura_wind_shot_desc: A gust shot blows a corridor clear ahead of you, pushing monsters aside. Bosses are unaffected.
keys.swarm.aura_wind_shot_up: A wider gust, a further push.
keys.swarm.aura_wind_shot_ten: Cyclone Arrow: an arrow carrying a tornado that drags monsters along.
keys.swarm.aura_flare_trail_desc: A flare skids along the ground the way you face, leaving a line of burning flares; anything that crosses it burns and is blinded.
keys.swarm.aura_flare_trail_up: A longer line that lasts longer, more often.
keys.swarm.aura_flare_trail_ten: Signal Fire: a column of fire on you calls down a barrage across the screen.
